blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-19. pmUSD is 100% on Ethereum (census). At Ethereum block 26224787, proxy 0xc0c17dd08263c16f6b64e772fb9b723bf1344ddf resolves to verified FractionalToken implementation 0x32d93b015562cc8da0ef3ccbccc3f8e1da8541d8; the ProxyAdmin 0x89ab60d8fcd674b2b0b308e7fa63ff84a2682ce2 is owned by RAAC Safe 0xCa3144AAD1f75557E68B16C8C7e893112418f13C. The current token exposes no blacklist, denylist, freeze, seizure, transfer-pause or arbitrary-burn selector. Its burn(address,uint256) is onlyTreasury; Treasury.redeem is onlyMarket and Market.redeem passes msg.sender as the burn owner, so manager redemption cannot burn another holder's balance. The RAAC Safe can still replace the token implementation at will, and it can regrant EMERGENCY_DAO_ROLE to re-enable the Market's pauseRedeem path. Those are direct holder-facing Possible controls, not an active Yes.

oracleRisk.summary: At Ethereum block 26096125, pmUSD Treasury.priceOracle() points to ChainlinkOracleAdapter 0x0236497082f693525dca8717787b0f601ad62ce6, whose single priceFeed is 0x214ed9da11d2fbe465a6fc601a91e62ebec1a0d6 and maxStaleTime is 87000 seconds. Treasury requires the adapter's validity flag before using its share price for collateral valuation; emergency pricing is not an independent valid fallback. The separate PSM sUSDS/USDS pricing leg does not make native issuance oracleless.

branchApplicability.rationale: RAAC's RWf(x) Treasury reads the Instruxi/Chainlink gold price to value fGOLD, calculate the system collateral ratio, determine pmUSD issuance, and rebalance the stable/leverage split. RAAC disables liquidation and self-liquidation, so pmUSD has no borrower-specific liquidation branches; the gold-price authority is top-level-only.
